title: 第七章 千古艰难唯一死
content_zh:
秦业迎着贾珩的目光注视，长叹了一口气，道：「贤侄有所不知……」
秦业终究不是那等依仗权势就翻脸无情的无耻之徒，就将刚刚见过贾珍的经过说来，当然如果贾珩知难而退，他也正好问心无愧。
秦业如此的心思，正是处在这般一种左右摇摆的复杂情景上。
贾珩沉吟半晌，自是察觉到秦业心头的纠结和矛盾，就问道：「秦世伯，我和令嫒婚书已定，秦世伯难道要悔婚不成？」
秦业面露苦笑，道：「老夫自是不会悔婚，只是此事毕竟牵涉到贵府族长，贤侄回去之后，难保不会再起波折啊。」
贾珩道：「有道是宁拆十座庙，不毁一桩婚，宁国府虽势大，但说破天去，也逃不过一个理字，况我也是贾族中人。」
但事实上，贾珍百分之百要胡来。
红楼梦原着多次提到贾府干涉，从王熙凤弄权铁槛寺，借长安节度之手，参与长安府尊和长安守备亲事之争，再到贾琏偷取尤二姨，凤姐对苦主张华的迫害，可以说，贾府这种事情乾的不是一件两件。
当然，他好在还姓贾，若事情闹大，他或可以寻贾母这位两府里辈分最高的老太太评理。
但能不能见到贾母，又在两可之间。
所以，此事需要提前防备。
他向来谋而后动。
若还未见秦可卿也就罢了，方才既已见得秦可卿，这要是一步退却，他岂不是成了被牛头人的苦主？
既存此念，贾珩目中现出坚定，沉声道：「秦世伯放心，宁国府那边，我会想办法周旋，世伯，我和令嫒的婚事，还请尽快议定下婚期，否则，贾府说不得还会再使手段。」
如是迎娶秦可卿，贾珍再想从中作梗，就要难上许多了。
秦业迟疑道：「贤侄，这太过仓促了吧。」
贾珩沉吟了下，正要劝说秦业，忽听得一声柔媚丶酥软的声音，「爹爹……」
帘子之后，倩影微动，现出一女来。
秦可卿在帘后听了半晌，闻听宁国府族长将代子提亲，就是脸色一变，
「你，如何出来了？」秦业脸色微变，这时代虽男女大防虽未如，但一未出阁女子，见于外男，还是有着几分不太妥当。

但秦业家终究是小门小户，倒也没有那麽多讲究。
「爹爹，方才之事，女儿已听了大半，既婚约早定，岂可轻易失信于人，纵有不妥之处，也是女儿之命了。」秦可卿看向秦业，清声说道。
见这一幕，贾珩也不由面色动容，他确是没想到，秦可卿竟能说出这番言语来。
也是，既能悬梁于天香楼，若无一分烈气，似乎也说不过去。
要知道，千古艰难唯一死，纵然是死，其实也是需要一定勇气的。
见秦可卿出来劝说，秦业苍老面容上现出无奈，终究长叹了一口气。
这位在工部蹉跎半辈子，性情本就绵软，否则也不会如此左右摇摆，若是拒绝贾珍，在陶然居就可开口言辞拒绝，贾珍还能强逼不成？
若要悔婚，就可直接作恶人，打发了贾珩。
但前者畏惧贾珍权势，后者又不想做恶人，同时担心贾珩来闹，于是两相为难，踯躅犹疑。
秦可卿显然是知道自家父亲性子的。
秦业面色变幻了下，说道：「罢了，罢了，婚约既定，岂可失信于人？宝珠，将姑娘带回去，这就见外男，成什麽样子。」
宝珠从一旁走过来，拉了下秦可卿的衣袖，小声道：「姑娘，先回去罢。」
秦可卿也反应过来，就羞红了面颊，方才也不知为何，心头一急，就走将出来，但此刻才知方才是多麽逾矩。
偷瞧了一眼那沉静依旧，气质清逸的少年，见其目光温煦地冲自己微微颔首，心跳加快几分，樱唇翕动了下，还未说什麽，就被宝珠拉着进了内宅。
「小女不知礼数，贤侄见笑了。」秦业叹了一口气，面色苦闷道。
贾珩面色一肃，说道：「哪里，令嫒重然诺，尚节义，当真是奇女子也。」
比起宁国府，他出身宁国旁支，家境清寒，秦可卿还能履诺，这就显得尤为可贵了。
尤其挺身而出，更是让人感佩。
秦可卿如此，他又岂能退缩？
听贾珩赞誉之语，秦业笑了笑，看向贾珩，道：「只是贤侄，要如何应对贾家？」

贾珩道：「贾珍虽为宁国之长，但我同为贾家一脉，其能行之策，左右越不过威逼利诱，若是闹大，我会先求荣国府的老太太，若事仍不谐，左右不过一场官司罢了。」
这时代，退婚就是这样，贾珍虽为宁国长房，但也并非一手遮天，真要逼得他一纸诉状告到官府，贾家也要头疼。
不过，以他估计，真的求到贾母那里，此事就此打住了。
秦业性情绵软，闻言，面带苦色，说道：「这……岂不是闹得满城风雨？」
贾珩叹了一口气，他自是理解秦业这种心态，但如今的他还真的没有多少筹码对抗贾家，说道：「秦世伯，那不过是最坏打算，贾珍虽强势跋扈，但若连族人姻缘都抢夺，西府的老太太一向是怜贫惜弱，岂会容他？」
秦业叹了一口气，道：「只得如此了，只是贤侄凡事三思而行，还是谨慎丶周全为要。」
贾珩道：「世伯放心，珩醒得利害。」
秦业虽觉得不太妥当，不过眼下也无法，还是与贾珩商定了婚期，待下个月的十五完婚。
待贾珩一走，秦业又是一阵唉声叹气，回到后院，看着秦可卿，道：「此事恐怕还有波折。」
秦可卿轻声道：「爹，既已经答应了人家，怎好轻易改口反悔？我看这贾公子也是个心志高的，你方才听他之言，也是刚直不屈的性子，若是说不好，恐还多生事端。」
秦业抬头，看向秦可卿，摇头道：「只是他家……比起宁国府来，苦了你了。」
秦可卿叹了一口气，幽幽道：「女儿也不是那贪慕富贵之人，再说宁国府那等钟鸣鼎食之家，咱们家小门小户的，也不好高攀，女儿既已许了人，若中途反悔，纵是嫁到宁国府，也要被人指指点点呢。」
秦业叹了一口气，默然不语。
贾珩出了秦家，脸色犹自明晦不定，他岂看不出秦业心理的纠结，至于秦可卿什麽心思，他一时也拿捏不住，女儿家的心思原就难猜。
不过，此女给他留下的第一印象还不错。若非如此，也不会入了贾母的眼，得其不住口的夸赞。
「娶亲还需一笔银子，同时，需得尽快考取功名，否则，哪怕将秦可卿娶回家，也保不住。」贾珩突然就生出一股紧迫感。
一路无话，心事重重地回到贾宅，刚一进入屋中，蔡氏自是问着经过，贾珩如实相告。
蔡氏道：「珩哥儿，此事你做得不错，若那宁国府敢胡来，我就去求问荣国府的老太太去。」
贾珩道：「婚事与秦家已经议定，现在当务之急，是尽快完婚，以防变数。」
只要秦可卿过门，贾珍才会偃旗息鼓，至于再有谋算，就只能见招拆招了。

蔡氏笑道：「哥儿不必担心银钱耗费，你成家立业，姑娘在时也留了几百两银子，完亲事是够用得了。」
贾珩感激道：「有劳蔡婶操持了。」

content_en:
Qin Ye met Jia Heng's gaze, sighed, and said, "My dear nephew, I don't know..."
After all, Qin Ye is not that shameless person who turns his face and becomes ruthless just because he relies on his power. Speaking of what happened when he just met Jia Zhen, of course, if Jia Heng retreats when he sees difficulties, he will have a clear conscience.
Qin Ye's thoughts were in such a complex situation of swinging left and right.
Jia Heng pondered for a long time, and then he noticed the entanglement and contradiction in Qin Ye's heart, and asked: "Qin Shibo, my daughter and I have signed a marriage contract. Does Qin Shibo want to regret the marriage?"
Qin Ye smiled bitterly and said, "I will not regret my marriage, but after all, this matter involves the clan leader of the noble family. After my nephew returns, there is no guarantee that there will be no more troubles."
Jia Heng said: "There is a saying that it would be better to demolish ten temples than to ruin one marriage. Although the Ningguo Mansion is powerful, there is no way to escape even the most powerful thing. Besides, I am also a member of the Jia clan."
But in fact, Jia Zhen is 100% up to no good.
The original Dream of Red Mansions mentioned the interference of Jia's family many times, from Wang Xifeng's taking control of Tieksuan Temple, borrowing the help of Chang'an Jiedu, and participating in the marriage dispute between Chang'an's prefect and Chang'an guard, to Jia Lian's stealing of Second Aunt You, and Sister Feng's persecution of Ku Zhang Hua. It can be said that Jia's family did more than one thing like this.
Of course, fortunately, his surname is Jia. If things get serious, he may seek comment from Jia's mother, the most senior old lady in the two houses.
But whether he can see Jia Mu is a matter of choice.
Therefore, this matter needs to be prepared in advance.
He always makes plans before taking action.
It's okay if he hasn't met Qin Keqing yet. He has just met Qin Keqing. If he takes one step back, wouldn't he become the victim of the tauren?
With this thought in mind, Jia Heng's eyes showed determination and he said in a deep voice: "Don't worry, Uncle Qin, I will find a way to deal with Ningguo Mansion. Shibo, please agree on a wedding date for your daughter and I as soon as possible, otherwise, the Jia Mansion will resort to tricks again."
If she marries Qin Keqing, it will be much more difficult for Jia Zhen to interfere with her marriage.
Qin Ye hesitated and said, "My dear nephew, this is too hasty."
Jia Heng pondered for a moment and was about to persuade Qin Ye when he suddenly heard a soft and charming voice, "Daddy..."
Behind the curtain, the beautiful figure moved slightly, and a woman appeared.
Qin Keqing listened behind the curtain for a long time. When he heard that the head of the Ningguo Mansion proposed marriage for his son, his expression changed.
"How did you get out?" Qin Ye's face changed slightly. Although men and women in this era were not as protected as men, it was still a bit inappropriate for a woman who had not left the palace to meet a foreign man.
But Qin Ye's family is a small family after all, so they don't pay that much attention.
"Dad, my daughter has already heard most of what happened just now. Since the engagement has been made long ago, how can we break trust easily? Even if there is something wrong, it is my daughter's fate." Qin Keqing looked at Qin Ye and said in a clear voice.
Seeing this scene, Jia Heng couldn't help but look moved. He really didn't expect Qin Keqing to say these words.
Also, even if it can be hung on the Tianxiang Tower, it seems unreasonable if there is no fierceness at all.
You must know that the only way to survive through the ages is to die. Even if it is death, it actually requires a certain amount of courage.
Seeing Qin Keqing come out to persuade him, Qin Ye's old face showed helplessness, and he finally let out a long sigh.
This person had wasted half his life in the Ministry of Industry and had a soft temperament, otherwise he would not be so swaying. If he rejected Jia Zhen, he could just say no in Tao Ranju. Can Jia Zhen still force her?
If you want to regret your marriage, you can just be a bad person and send Jia Heng away.
However, the former was afraid of Jia Zhen's power, and the latter did not want to be a bad person. At the same time, he was worried that Jia Heng would make trouble, so he was in a dilemma and hesitated.
Qin Keqing obviously knew his father's temperament.
Qin Ye's expression changed, and he said, "That's it, that's all, the engagement has been made, how can we break one's promise? Baozhu, take the girl back, and see what the foreign man will be like."
Baozhu walked over from the side, pulled down Qin Keqing's sleeve, and whispered: "Girl, go back first."stop. "
Qin Keqing also reacted, and her cheeks turned red with embarrassment. She didn't know why just now, but she felt anxious and was about to leave. But now she realized how much she had exceeded the rules.
He took a peek at the young man who remained calm and elegant, and saw that he nodded slightly at him with warm eyes, his heart beat faster, his lips twitched, and before he said anything, he was pulled into the inner house by Baozhu.
"My little girl doesn't know her etiquette, but my nephew is laughing at her." Qin Ye sighed and said with a depressed expression.
Jia Heng looked solemn and said, "Where is my concubine? She is so committed and upholds integrity. She is truly a strange woman."
Compared with Ningguo Mansion, he was born in a branch of Ningguo and his family was poor. Qin Keqing was able to fulfill his promise, which was particularly valuable.
Especially for stepping forward, it is even more admirable.
Qin Keqing is like this, how can he back down?
Hearing Jia Heng's praise, Qin Ye smiled, looked at Jia Heng, and said, "I'm just a good nephew, how should I deal with the Jia family?"
Jia Heng said: "Although Jia Zhen is the head of the Ning Kingdom, I am of the same lineage as the Jia family. What she can do is beyond coercion and inducement. If there is a big problem, I will first seek help from the old lady of the Rongguo Mansion. If things are still not harmonious, it will be nothing more than a lawsuit."
In this era, breaking off an engagement is like this. Although Jia Zhen is the eldest daughter of Ning State, she does not have everything to cover the sky. If he is really forced to file a complaint with the government, the Jia family will also have a headache.
However, in his estimation, if he really asked Jia Mu, the matter would stop there.
Qin Ye had a soft temperament. When he heard this, he said with a bitter look on his face: "Isn't this... not making the city full of trouble?"
Jia Heng sighed. He understood Qin Ye's mentality, but now he really didn't have much leverage to fight against the Jia family. He said, "Qin Shibo, that is just the worst plan. Although Jia Zhen is strong and domineering, if she even robs the marriage of her clan members, the old lady of Xifu has always shown pity to the poor and the weak, how can she tolerate him?"
Qin Ye sighed and said, "That's all I have to do. My dear nephew, I think twice about everything. It's better to be cautious and thorough."
Jia Heng said: "Don't worry, Uncle Shi, it will be beneficial for Heng to wake up."
Although Qin Ye felt it was not appropriate, he had no choice but to agree on a wedding date with Jia Heng, and they would get married on the fifteenth day of next month.
As soon as Jia Heng left, Qin Ye sighed again, returned to the backyard, looked at Qin Keqing, and said, "I'm afraid there are still twists and turns in this matter."
Qin Keqing said softly: "Father, you have already promised someone, how can you change your mind so easily? I think Mr. Jia is also a high-minded person. You just listened to his words, and he is also upright and unyielding. If you don't say it well, you may cause more trouble."
Qin Ye raised his head, looked at Qin Keqing, shook his head and said, "It's just that his family...has suffered more for you than Ning Guofu."
Qin Keqing sighed and said quietly: "My daughter is not a person who covets wealth. Besides, it is not easy for people from our small family to reach high places such as Ningguo Mansion. If my daughter goes back on her promise midway, she will be criticized even if she marries to Ningguo Mansion."
Qin Ye sighed and remained silent.
Jia Heng left Qin's house, his expression still unclear. Couldn't he see Qin Ye's psychological tangle? As for what Qin Keqing was thinking, he couldn't figure it out at the moment. It was difficult to guess what his daughter's family was thinking.
However, the first impression this woman left on him was not bad. If not, he wouldn't have caught Jia Mu's eyes and won her endless praise.
"You still need a sum of money to get married, and at the same time, you need to get the title as soon as possible. Otherwise, even if you marry Qin Keqing home, you won't be able to keep it." Jia Heng suddenly felt a sense of urgency.
The whole journey was silent and full of thoughts, and she returned to Jia's house. As soon as she entered the house, Cai asked about the incident, and Jia Heng told the truth.
Cai said: "Brother Heng, you have done a good job in this matter. If the Ningguo Mansion dares to do anything wrong, I will ask the old lady of the Rongguo Mansion."
Jia Heng said: "The marriage has been agreed upon with the Qin family. The top priority now is to get married as soon as possible to prevent changes."
As long asWhen Qin Keqing comes through, Jia Zhen will cease her activities. As for her plans, she can only resort to tricks.
Ms. Cai smiled and said, "Brother, you don't have to worry about money consumption. You have started a family and started a business. The girl also left a few hundred taels of silver when she was here. It will be enough for the wedding."
Jia Heng said gratefully, "Thank you Aunt Cai for taking care of it."
